title: A Thorn for the Salt
author: Rosalind Okafor
blurb: Orsen Halloran, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
